records.name: Remote Desktop Commander
records.purpose: Bounded device and terminal probes.
records.notes: Exposed in this session. Parent reports Windows and Ubuntu responded; no broad device execution authorization.

records.name: GitHub / Copilot
records.purpose: Repository review and code assistance.
records.notes: Local gh public metadata fetch executed. Parent reports WD gh authenticated and active org-admin verified. Copilot execution is not tested.

records.name: Codex
records.purpose: Reviewable code implementation and bounded jobs.
records.notes: Parent reports codex-cli 0.153.4 logged in using ChatGPT on WD. This workspace has no codex command on PATH; new persisted CLI session is not verified.

records.name: WSL
records.purpose: Linux runtime boundary for scientific tools.
records.notes: Parent reports Ubuntu responded and is WSL1, not WSL2. This says nothing about pipeline installation.

records.name: NCBI Datasets
records.purpose: Versioned RefSeq metadata and genome packages.
records.notes: Frozen accession text fetched through gh. No live Datasets CLI or genome download ran here.

records.name: GToTree
records.purpose: Conserved single-copy marker workflow.
records.notes: Host-tree chain; live marker extraction not tested.

records.name: HMMER
records.purpose: Profile-based conserved marker searches.
records.notes: Retain marker identity; audit copy number and homology.

records.name: MAFFT
records.purpose: Separate alignments for homologous markers.
records.notes: Do not align all proteins as one homologous set.

records.name: trimAl
records.purpose: Review alignment trimming per marker.
records.notes: Retain pre/post lengths, masks and marker provenance.

records.name: IQ-TREE
records.purpose: Protein host-tree inference with support estimates.
records.notes: No tree, model fit or bootstrap/support run executed here.

records.name: DefenseFinder
records.purpose: Independent R-M candidate annotation.
records.notes: Needs ordered per-replicon genes and matching GFF; candidates require review.

records.name: REBASE
records.purpose: R-M curation reference.
records.notes: Review source terms and cite record identities; no content bulk import.

records.name: Literature search
records.purpose: Find primary evidence for curated system claims.
records.notes: Web and literature connectors exposed; no R-M literature search executed in this build.

records.name: Geneious / iTOL
records.purpose: Sequence review and annotated figure presentation.
records.notes: Figure layer only. Product access, license and execution remain unknown.

records.name: NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit
records.purpose: Optional GPU/model workflow assistance.
records.notes: Parent verified 0.1.0 plugin files and read genomics-workflow-acceleration and msa-search-nim skills on WD. No GPU/NIM job executed; not full readiness.

records.name: smarts.bio
records.purpose: Optional external scientific assistant.
records.notes: Parent direct invocation returned user not logged in. Authentication blocked; scientific execution not established.

records.name: AlphaGenome
records.purpose: Optional regulatory-model investigation.
records.notes: Not a replacement for bacterial host phylogeny or R-M review. Vendor terms remain separate; no model called.

records.name: Native ChatGPT Sites
records.purpose: Separate native helper delivery target.
records.notes: Create, save and deploy tools exposed. Save requires source push; parent review hold prevents publication. No preview/version/deployment receipt exists.
